Questions? We've Got You Covered

Why can’t I watch the World Cup matches in Spanish with English subtitles?
Coverage of FIFA World Cup 2026TMon Peacock is available in Spanish only, including audio and subtitles.
Why are some MLB games unavailable to stream on Peacock?
Due to territorial blackout restrictions, select regular season, special event, and Postseason games may be unavailable on Peacock. Television territory blackout restrictions apply regardless of whether a Club is home or away and regardless of whether a game is televised in that Club's home television territory. For more information visit, Peacock's Help Center.
How can I sign up for the Apple TV and Peacock bundle?
Learn more about the Apple TV and Peacock bundle here.
What's Peacock?
Peacock is a streaming service from NBCUniversal. With tons of hit movies and TV shows, Originals, current NBC & Bravo hits, and LIVE Sports including Premier League, WWE, Golf, Cycling, and more, Peacock is here for whatever you’re in the mood for, from bingewatching to channel surfing. Sign up here to start streaming.
What can I watch with Peacock Premium vs. Peacock Premium Plus?
With Peacock Premium, you can stream hundreds of hit movies, full seasons of iconic TV shows and bingeworthy Peacock Original series, the latest hits from NBC & Bravo, can't-miss live sports, and Peacock Channels 24/7, plus daily live news, late night, and more to satisfy your FOMO. You’ll also get access to kids’ movies and shows, hit Spanish-language TV shows, and news from Telemundo.

To watch Peacock without ads (limited exclusions)* or download select shows and movies to watch offline on your mobile device, upgrade to Peacock Premium Plus. You'll also get access to your local NBC channel LIVE, 24/7.

*Certain pages are sponsored, and some programming will still contain ads (channels, live sports and events, and a few shows and movies). Some titles available to watch offline.
What devices does Peacock support?
Lots! For instance:

TV
Android TV, Apple TV, COX, Fire TV, LG TV, Hisense VIDAA, Roku, Samsung, Vizio Smart TV, Xfinity

Computer
Chrome OS, macOS, Windows PC

Mobile & Tablet
Android phones & tablets, Fire Tablet, iPhone and iPad

Game Consoles
PlayStation, Xbox, Meta VR devices

View a list of all supported devices here. (If you don’t see it listed, we’re probably working on it!)
Does Peacock have a discount for students?
Yes, eligible college/university students can get 12 months of Peacock Premium at $5.99/mo, instead of the current rate of $10.99/mo. Existing Peacock subscribers may need to take additional steps to redeem. To learn more, visit PeacockTV.com/Student.
Where can I get a Peacock Gift Card?
You can purchase Peacock Gift Cards online. New and existing subscribers can redeem Peacock gift cards by visiting peacocktv.com/gift-cards and entering the redemption code.

Your Privacy Choices: Opt-out of sale or sharing of personal information and opt out of targeted ads

When you interact with us or our services, we may disclose personal information to third parties, partners, and NBCUniversal’s Related Businesses as described in our Privacy Policy. Some of this activity may be considered a "sale" or "share” under applicable law (residents of applicable states can learn more here). To opt out of such “sale” or “sharing,” follow the steps below. Opting out will also prevent the processing of your personal information for targeted ads.

  • For direct contact information such as your name, email address and other associated personal information, please submit the form below first.
  • For cookies and devices identifiers: switch the “Allow Sale/Share/Targeted Ads” toggle under Manage Preferences to OFF (grey color) by moving it LEFT and clicking “Confirm My Choice.” You must log in to your account first if you want your choice to apply across browsers and devices that you access through your account. This will close this box, so please open the Opt-Out Form first.

Please note: Opting out will also prevent disclosure of personal information to our Related Businesses (except as necessary for the provision of services or when you permit to such disclosure).

You will still see ads, but they may be less relevant or based only on our first-party information about you.

Your choices related to cookies and device identifiers will apply to devices accessed with your logged in account if you opt out (or opt back in) when you are logged in. If you are not logged in, your choice will only apply to this browser, and you will need to renew this choice on each browser or device where you want your choice to apply or if you clear your browser cookies.
